result.message: Testing stage. You will be given 3 test inputs, one at a time and answered separately. Apply the same transformation rule to each and submit the predicted output grid with submit_final_answer.

output.arguments:
{"code":"def transform(grid):
    out=[]
    for row in grid:
        n=len(row); groups=0; on=False
        for x in row:
            if x and not on: groups+=1
            on=bool(x)
        k=4-groups if groups else 0
        k%=n
        out.append(row[k:]+row[:k])
    return out"}

output.arguments:
{"code":"def transform(grid):
 out=[r[:] for r in grid]
 for i,r in enumerate(grid):
  nz=[j for j,x in enumerate(r) if x]
  if not nz: continue
  # cyclic shift left: singleton component shifts its width; multiple components shift one
  comps=0; prev=-2; widths=[]; w=0
  for j in nz:
   if j!=prev+1:
    comps+=1
    if w: widths.append(w)
    w=1
   else: w+=1
   prev=j
  widths.append(w)
  k=widths[0] if comps==1 else 1
  k%=len(r)
  out[i]=r[k:]+r[:k]
 return out"}
